title: Bringing Claude models in Microsoft Copilot into the EU Data Boundary
summary: Greater model choice, consistent protection. Claude models are coming to the EU Data Boundary in Microsoft Copilot.

title: Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management: Reimagine creation Phase In/Out rules to make it easier for users to enter in large volumes
summary: Reimagine creation Phase In/Out rules. Allow users to pre-select Tables and Fields at Group level that will be populated on every rules. If a Table key field like Product ID is included in the rules, then auto fill related fields with values like Product Name, Product Group etc. Support for Phase In a new Product with out pointing to and old Product. Support Delete of a Dimension or Dimension combination so it no longer appear in timeseries Investigate if rules can be created via Copilot - Cowor

title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Chat: Access to UBB models via the model selector
summary: Users will be able to access models that require usage-based billing (UBB) from the model selector in Chat. Tenant admins will need to allocate credits so that users can interact with these models. If users consume their allotted credits, they will be able to request credits from their tenant admins. GA date: December CY2026 Preview date: November CY2026
